questions.q: What item and quantity does Dana Whitfield requisition, and what is the total purchase order amount?
options: 400 units of Model CP-220 Control Panel, $58,000.00
50 units of Industrial Pump Bearing PB-4400, $18,400.00
50 units of Industrial Pump Bearing PB-4400, $9,200.00
14 units of a freight service item, $4,250.00
questions.explain: Dana's requisition becomes PO-55210: 50 units of Industrial Pump Bearing PB-4400 at $368.00 each, totaling $18,400.00.

questions.q: Why does Self Service Procurement automatically suggest Meridian Bearing Supply Co. for this requisition?
options: Meridian is the only supplier configured in the system
Meridian is flagged as the preferred supplier for this item category
Meridian offered the lowest price in a formal bid
Dana Whitfield has a personal relationship with Meridian
questions.explain: Lesson 6 flagged Meridian Bearing Supply Co. as the preferred supplier, which is why it surfaces automatically for this item category.

questions.q: Which account combination does PO-55210 charge, and why that account?
options: 1000-410-7410-0000-000, Utilities Expense, because it's a plant cost
1000-420-1410-0000-000, Inventory — Raw Materials, because PB-4400 is a stocked item
2000-420-1410-0000-000, because the bearings are used by the Canadian plant
1000-420-2110-0000-000, Accounts Payable — Trade
questions.explain: Because PB-4400 is a stocked MRO item, it's charged to Fabrication's inventory account under the US entity: 1000-420-1410-0000-000.

questions.q: What matching level is specified for PO-55210?
options: Two-way matching (PO and invoice only)
Four-way matching with inspection
Three-way matching (PO, receipt, and invoice)
No matching is required for MRO purchases
questions.explain: PO-55210 is matched at the three-way level: purchase order, receipt, and invoice.

questions.q: Why does this lesson specifically call out PO-55210's December 22 date?
options: December 22 is LTV's fiscal year-end
It has no particular significance
Because the PO crosses a period boundary — received in December but invoiced in January, the exact shape of a GRNI accrual that resurfaces later
Because all purchase orders must be dated before December 25
questions.explain: The December-to-January timing gap is deliberately set up to create a goods-received-not-invoiced situation that matters again in lesson 17 and Chapter 3.
